issues.summary: The only kept signal is a DeepSeek feature request whose author explicitly wants to avoid self-hosting, yet the reply pitches a product that now requires running your own server.
issues.evidence: Issue body (github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3/issues/1643): "forcing users to rely on complex self-hosted solutions like Termux + Ollama + Open WebUI"; signals[0].drafted_reply: "You'd run the server yourself, so documents never leave your machine"
issues.cause_hint: signals rescore judges topic match only; it does not check the asker's stated constraint against profile.gaps (self-host only) or maturity.stage=sunset

issues.summary: The drafted reply contradicts itself on privacy and adds unverified capabilities: it says DeepSeek can be the LLM and also that documents never leave the machine, and promises the 'memory controls you described'.
issues.evidence: signals[0].drafted_reply: "supports DeepSeek as the underlying LLM, and has Android and WhatsApp clients ... documents never leave your machine, and you get the citation and memory controls you described. I built it"
issues.cause_hint: signals reply prompt: no check of reply claims against profile differentiators (profile says 'phone', not Android; nothing about editable memory)

issues.summary: The signal's date is stored as unknown although the issue carries a creation date (2026-09-13), so recency was not verified from the source.
issues.evidence: signals[0].posted_when: "unknown"
issues.cause_hint: signals scan: GitHub issue created_at not read

issues.summary: The voice-over claims 'Nothing leaves your machine', which is false for a product whose headline feature is using cloud LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini) over your documents, and a self-host server is not necessarily your machine.
issues.evidence: studio voice segment 'how': "Drop in your docs. It searches, indexes, and cites. Nothing leaves your machine."; profile.differentiators: "Supports any local or cloud LLM interchangeably: ... gpt, claude, gemini, deepseek"
issues.cause_hint: voice/script prompt drifts to a generic privacy beat; no claim check against the profile

issues.summary: Reel 'how it works' beats use template words, not Khoj's real UI or categories: a BUILD button and FOUND/INDEXED/CITED/OPEN chips that the beat spec says must be the product's real categories.
issues.evidence: studio script slots: "step1_button": "BUILD", "chip_1": "FOUND", "chip_2": "INDEXED", "chip_3": "CITED", "chip_4": "OPEN", "step3_label": "NOTHING SLIPS. IT STAYS."; beat spec: "The chips are the product's real categories."
issues.cause_hint: verdict concept template in studio script pipe; the concept fits a review/triage product, not a chat assistant

issues.summary: The reel's product beat uses the khoj.dev screenshot, which is now the company page promoting Open Paper and Pipali, not the Khoj app.
issues.evidence: studio probe copy: "a: NEWPipali - Our desktop AI co-worker", "h2: Our products", "h3: Open Paper"; reel: "screenshot_used": true, product_line "INTELLIGENCE YOU CAN TRUST."

issues.summary: The sunset rule forbids asking anyone to install the product, yet the reel, voice and listing CTA tell viewers to self-host now, while the posts claim no install ask was made; the rule and the angle conflict and outputs apply it inconsistently.
issues.evidence: reel slots: "arrive_line": "SELF-HOST IT NOW."; voice 'close': "Self-host it today. That's Khoj."; rulebooks.ts GLOBAL: "never ask anyone to install, start, sign up for or buy it"; x_post warning: "does not ask anyone to install, sign up, or start a trial"
issues.cause_hint: rulebooks.ts sunset rule has no carve-out for a live self-host path; studio script prompt does not apply it

best: The profile and the handling of the sunset: it read app.khoj.dev, quoted the April 15, 2026 notice, got stars and forks exactly right (37,545 / 2,497), and every post discloses the shutdown in its first sentences without inventing a reason. The X and LinkedIn posts are close to usable as they are.
worst: Signals and assets. The one kept signal is a person who explicitly does not want to self-host, answered with a reply that contradicts itself ('supports DeepSeek' and 'documents never leave your machine'). The reel voice-over makes the same false privacy claim and uses template how-it-works beats.
notes: Judged newest rows: reddit_post v2 (draft, r/selfhosted) for the Reddit score; studio reel v1 draft (not approved, drive stuck on Approve reel, which is appropriate given the faults). Live checks: app.khoj.dev sunset text matches the profile; GitHub API confirms 37,545 stars, 2,497 forks, last push 2026-08-02, founder commits June 2026; khoj.dev now a company page (Open Paper, Pipali, Khoj app) with Roboto / Source Serif 4 and a #282828 on #fff palette; prior Show HN 2023-07-30 (565 points). The main systemic tension is that the sunset rule ('never ask anyone to install') conflicts with the chosen self-host migration angle, and stages resolve it differently. Plan not ready (reel unapproved, Reddit gate).
